fields.summary_ko.0: With Amazon.com AWS growth and Anthropic IPO approaching, substantial net income must be generated from AWS and advertising operating cash flow rather than from mark-to-market gains on Anthropic stakes.
fields.summary_ko.1: AWS execution and backlog conversion are near-term catalysts, while annual capital expenditures of $220 billion that fail to monetize could pose long-term cash outflow risks.
fields.summary_ko.2: Amazon's narrative fair value is estimated at US$280.21, with success contingent on whether projects like Leo satellites and Anthropic cloud commitments convert to actual high-margin cash earnings.
